description: Search for users in a single Canvas account by name, login, or email, returning matching Canvas user objects. Use `include` to add email, last_login, avatar_url, time_zone, or uuid to each result, and `sort`/`order` to control the ordering. This is one account-scoped search — to check whether one student is enrolled anywhere across an educator's own active and concluded courses, use find_student_across_courses instead; to list every user in one course without a search term, use list_course_users; to list an entire account's users unfiltered, use list_account_users. Because results carry no enrollment data, pseudonymized mode cannot tell staff from students and anonymizes every returned user's name and email.

include.description: Extra fields to include on each user (Canvas include[] param)

search_term.description: The search term (name, login, or email)

name: search_users
title: Search Users
